name: MyOutcomes
company_name: MyOutcomes LLC / ICCE (International Center for Clinical Excellence)
short_description: Feedback Informed Treatment (FIT) platform featuring ORS and SRS assessments. Developed by Scott Miller and the ICCE, enabling routine outcome monitoring and therapeutic alliance tracking.
long_description: MyOutcomes is the official digital platform for implementing Feedback Informed Treatment (FIT), the evidence-based practice developed by Scott D. Miller, PhD and Barry Duncan, PsyD. The platform administers the ultra-brief Outcome Rating Scale (ORS) and Session Rating Scale (SRS) - each taking under one minute to complete - at every session to track client progress and therapeutic alliance. FIT research demonstrates that routine use of ORS/SRS can double the effectiveness of treatment and cut dropout rates in half. MyOutcomes provides real-time visual feedback, expected treatment response trajectories, alerts for clients not progressing, and aggregate outcome reports for practice benchmarking. The platform is backed by the International Center for Clinical Excellence (ICCE) and is used by thousands of practitioners worldwide to implement deliberate practice principles in clinical work.

seo.meta_description: MyOutcomes delivers Feedback Informed Treatment (FIT) with ORS and SRS assessments. Ultra-brief outcome and alliance tracking from $15/month. Scott Miller / ICCE.

faqs.a: FIT is an evidence-based practice using routine client feedback (ORS/SRS) at every session to track progress and therapeutic alliance. Research shows FIT can double treatment effectiveness and cut dropout rates in half.

faqs.q: What is the Outcome Rating Scale (ORS)?
faqs.a: The ORS is a 4-item visual analog scale administered at the start of each session. It measures individual wellbeing, interpersonal relationships, social role functioning, and overall sense of wellbeing in under one minute.

faqs.q: What is the Session Rating Scale (SRS)?
faqs.a: The SRS is a 4-item scale administered at the end of each session to measure therapeutic alliance across relationship quality, agreement on goals, and the therapist's approach.
MyOutcomes costs $15/month for individual practitioners or $150/year. Group practice pricing starts at $12/practitioner/month with volume discounts for larger organizations.
